pivot_note: pivot: pixels from the PNG's top-left; model_xy: where the pivot sits at rest (model units, feet at y 0)

board_face.desc: the board's face: CIRCUIT BREAK and the starting grid (Revvo first, Luigi last), a red frame with bulbs; pivot at the middle of the bottom edge (it falls about it)

board_back.desc: the board's back: planks and struts, for when it lies face down; same size and pivot

legs.desc: two steel legs with an X brace; the board's bottom edge sits on their tops (y 22)

rest_note: model_xy is where each pivot sits standing; the board falls about its pivot
